text:
in the claustros of the soul the wound
yace callada; mas consume hambrienta
the life, that in my venas alimenta
llama the medulas extendida.


Bebe the ardor hidrópica my life,
that already ceniza lover and macilenta,
cadáver of the incendio beautiful, ostenta
his light in humo and night fallecida.


the gente esquivo, and me is horror the day;
dilato in largas voces black weeping,
that a sordo sea my ardiente sorrow envía.


A the suspiros di the voice of the song,
the confusión inunda l’soul mía:
my heart is reino of the espanto.
